title.narrative: Green Bond Rapid Technical Assistance - Latin America and the Caribbean

description.narrative: Active

Due to delays in the operationalization of the GGBI program, the European Commission is seeking "quick wins" to lay the foundations for GGBI and show results as soon as possible after GGBI issuance. Funding will come from the EuroClima LAC envelope . This funding is additional to GGBI EUR 5M. 1. Dominican Republic Sovereign Green Bond 2. FIRA, Mexico Blue Bond 3. Luxemburg Stock Exchange - LAC Stock Exchanges knowledge sharing 4. 3 issuances from first-time green bond issuers. 5. Saint Lucia Blue Bond (idea 2180)
